data.long_meaning: Jelene is derived from the Slavic element ‘jelo’ meaning ‘dawn’ or ‘daybreak’. This name is associated with new beginnings, hope, and the promise of a bright future. In Christianity, Jelene may symbolize the rising sun of salvation. The name Jelene carries the meaning “Light, Dawn” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jelene usually hope their child will grow to embody light, dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jelene total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
data.cultural_impact: Jelene has been used as a personal name for centuries in Eastern European cultures. It carries the essence of the natural world and its beauty, as well as the hope and optimism associated with the arrival of the new day. This name can be seen as a reminder of the cyclical nature of life and the possibility for renewal and transformation.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, Jelene may symbolize the rising sun of salvation, a new beginning brought about by the grace of God. The name can be seen as a reminder of the promise of eternal life, and the hope that lies in the resurrection of Jesus Christ. Jelene may also be viewed as a name that embodies the light of Christ, shining in the world and illuminating the path for those who follow Him. Ultimately, this name is an embodiment of the beauty, hope, and renewal that can be found in the love of God.
